summary.text: Rey Martinez is a Republican state representative from Loganville who has represented Georgia House District 111 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Democrat Scott Jackson.
A business owner, he served in the U.S. Navy and U.S. Navy Reserve.

paragraphs.text: Martinez lives in Loganville, Georgia, and served in the U.S. Navy and U.S. Navy Reserve.
His career experience includes owning Rey's Cuban Grill.
Martinez won House District 111 in 2022, defeating Ryan Cox in the general election, and was re-elected in 2024 over Scott Jackson.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture and Consumer Affairs, Defense and Veterans Affairs, Intragovernmental Coordination, and Small Business Development committees, serving as vice chair of Small Business Development.
